evidence: The heart-rate main page allocates its state object into 0x2011f99c and clears that slot after freeing it on destruction. The identified show/refresh paths resolve their corresponding language keys and pass the results as argument 1 to the common label-text veneer. The measuring state has two separate call sites. The label objects are stored inside dynamic page state or local variables, so caller plus active-state filters define scope.
scope: the specified heart-rate main-page status label writes while its state object is alive
limitations: These hooks alter status text only, not measured heart rate, alerts or health data. The page state is not a proof of system-wide quiescence for the shared setter. Static analysis only.
